doc: Every transition is external: a self-transition, a transition from a composite to its own substate and one from a substate to its ancestor all leave and re-enter the state they start or end in.

steps.doc: Composite self-transition: children exit first, then P; P is re-entered by default.
P to its own grandchild D2: P is left and re-entered; the regions on the way to D2 are not entered by default.
D2 to its ancestor P: everything up to and including P is left, P is re-entered by default.
D1 to its parent D: D is left and re-entered, P stays.
Exits two levels at once, innermost first.
